create_train_shadows.configuration.title: Create: Train Shadows
create_train_shadows.configuration.opaci: How dark the shadow is where it is darkest, in full light. Vanilla entity shadows use 0.5.
create_train_shadows.configuration.fadeD: Camera distance, in blocks, at which the shadow has faded out completely. Vanilla uses 16.
create_train_shadows.configuration.fadeH: Once a train is higher above the ground than the grace height, the shadow fades out over this many blocks.
create_train_shadows.configuration.grace: Height above the lowest part of the train that still counts as touching the ground. Create hangs a train one block above its track.
create_train_shadows.configuration.margi: How far the shadow reaches past the outline of the train on every side, in blocks.
create_train_shadows.configuration.softn: Width of the band along the outer edge of the shadow in which it fades from nothing to full darkness, in blocks. 0 gives a hard edge.
